notes: The pattern allowed the address with or without a trailing slash; one form was kept.
Shortened the site's own address to its path.

rejected.reason: This rewrite changes what page is shown without sending the visitor anywhere (no “permanent” or “redirect”), so it isn't a redirect.
Only exact locations (“location = /old { return 301 /new; }”) are plain redirects.
A return outside a “location = …” block sends a whole server somewhere, which isn't one redirect.
